summary: Practise risk-based scoping, evidence testing, and audit reporting for complex processes. Explore the five-day course and outline.
lede: Auditing in complex environments examines governance, risks, and controls across interdependent processes, teams, and records. For internal auditors, audit managers, and assurance professionals, the course focuses on planning and conducting defensible reviews when control ownership, evidence, and records span multiple areas. Learners practise risk-based scoping, process mapping, evidence evaluation, and control testing, then document findings and track actions using workpapers and Excel-based trackers and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who scope, test, supervise, or act on assurance work where processes, records, and control ownership span multiple teams or service providers.
modules: Findings, Root Cause and Action Tracking
prerequisites: Working knowledge of audit or assurance processes is expected. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with Excel available; the exercises use provided sample files and do not require a separate account.
